card.name: Space before ACTEMRA dose numbers
card.fires_on: The space just before a dose number in ACTEMRA (tocilizumab) dosing text, such as 4 mg per kg or 162 mg, and sometimes the digit 4 itself. It also fires after "single" before an infusion time.

modes.label: Space before dose amount
modes.description: A space right after "to", "at", or "is" and before the dose number in ACTEMRA dosing instructions.
